contentBlocks.body: A template literal is a string written with backticks. Inside it, ${expression} is replaced with the value of that expression, which keeps string building readable.
**Worked example.** A template literal uses backticks. Each placeholder evaluates an expression and inserts its string representation. The arithmetic runs before the final text is assembled.
Single quotes keep ${name} as literal text instead of substituting the value.

**Try a small change.** Add a second line to the message and predict the exact whitespace.

Then complete the independent check below without copying the example. Explain the boundary case in words before running it.
